descriptionByLocale.en:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Partnering Business department and bring your passion and talent to work.

(Associate) Customer Product Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Customer Product Manager, you will be the primary liaison for coordinating and driving our Partnering Business partner products — with a special focus on customized solutions based on platform products— with all internal and external stakeholders. You will support the Partnering Business sales teams in contractual and pricing negotiations, outline value propositions, and drive alignment sessions. Your role involves managing trade-offs between client business demands, product life cycle stages, and Tecan business needs to create win/win positions. You will also contribute to the development of the Customer Product Management team with entrepreneurial thinking and market insights.

Responsibilities

• Manage and oversee all day-to-day lifecycle and operational aspects for assigned projects and products, including business and quality review meetings, regular conference calls, and product change management.

• Drive customer satisfaction and support Tecan’s Partnering Business marketing, financial, and growth objectives through operational excellence and proactive life cycle management.

• Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements and maintain relevant product documentation.

• Monitor and manage product forecasting, orders, and deliveries, and drive necessary actions in alignment with key stakeholders.

• Lead the Product Care Team, manage product-related KPIs, and ensure on-time delivery of agreed items.

• Support the sales organization in preparing and negotiating contracts, and monitor contract expirations and obligations.

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and spot and identify client trends.

• Play a key role in efficiently managing the lifecycle of platform-based products by applying established processes and driving continuous improvement initiatives

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering, with further education in Product Management or Business Administration.

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life science business.

• Experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and product/lifecycle management.

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• Strong negotiation skills and experience in executing complex contracts.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations.

• Team-oriented, entrepreneurial thinking, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated.

• Willingness to travel worldwide (5-10%).

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Partnering Business department and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Manager Key Account Products (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Manager Key Account Products, you are responsible to manage and oversee all business operations related to Key Account OEM customer products of Tecan’s IVD & Life Sciences Partnering Business. You will be the main contact person for key account customer(s) in day-to-day operations, from late-stage development to market launch readiness, managing the product life cycle during multi-year supply phase until end of life/ next generation solution development. Your responsibilities lie in managing the key account partners systems products ensuring product success through quality and supply performance as well as market growth by driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products. You are the key liaison for the customers to internal counterparts in R&D, Operations, Service, Quality and Regulatory. With your strong customer focus, communication skills and business acumen, you drive customer satisfaction, build long-lasting business partnerships and drive business growth with key accounts.

Responsibilities

• Act as central point of contact for Key Account customers for all day-to-day operational aspects regarding their Systems products, represent the client interests from development to end of life in internal teams

• Oversee operational life cycle management of existing products, ensuring customer satisfaction, compliance, documentation, and financial performance in close collaboration with the dedicated Sales counterpart

• Lead key client meetings like quarterly business reviews, quality reviews as well as internal product care meetings, steering meetings, with regular attendance of executives

• Guide customers through design and regulatory changes and global or local events impacting their business (e.g. tariffs)

• Maintain and manage budget, sales, and forecasts for assigned accounts, ensuring adherence to contract terms in collaboration with Sales

• Oversee product profitability and drive improvement measures with stakeholders

• Lead Product Care Team for assigned products and product families, defining and monitoring critical KPIs, regularly reporting to customers and Tecan management

• Implement corrective measures when KPIs deviate from targets, leading cross-functional teams to ensure success

• Apply your business mindset and client & market understanding to grow the partnership through driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products that align with the client’s needs

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and continuously seek improvements to Tecan processes

• Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion within the team and broader organization.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering; further education in Product Management, Project Management or Business Administration

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life sciences

• 5+ years’ experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and/or product/lifecycle management

• Experience working with customers/partners in a B2B setting, OEM experience is a plus

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and/or complex products (HW, SW, services)

• Expertise in negotiating complex contracts, particularly in development and supply agreements is a plus

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations

• Strong communication skills, experience in communication to executives is a plus

• Team-oriented, customer-focused, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated

• Willingness to travel worldwide (10–20%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Senior Manager Key Account Products (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Manager Key Account Products, you are responsible to manage and oversee all business operations related to Key Account OEM customer products of Tecan’s IVD & Life Sciences Partnering Business. You will be the main contact person for key account customer(s) in day-to-day operations, from late-stage development to market launch readiness, managing the product life cycle during multi-year supply phase until end of life/ next generation solution development. Your responsibilities lie in managing the key account partners systems products ensuring product success through quality and supply performance as well as market growth by driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products. You are the key liaison for the customers to internal counterparts in R&D, Operations, Service, Quality and Regulatory. With your strong customer focus, communication skills and business acumen, you drive customer satisfaction, build long-lasting business partnerships and drive business growth with key accounts.

Responsibilities

• Act as central point of contact for Key Account customers for all day-to-day operational aspects regarding their Systems products, represent the client interests from development to end of life in internal teams

• Oversee operational life cycle management of existing products, ensuring customer satisfaction, compliance, documentation, and financial performance in close collaboration with the dedicated Sales counterpart

• Lead key client meetings like quarterly business reviews, quality reviews as well as internal product care meetings, steering meetings, with regular attendance of executives

• Guide customers through design and regulatory changes and global or local events impacting their business (e.g. tariffs)

• Maintain and manage budget, sales, and forecasts for assigned accounts, ensuring adherence to contract terms in collaboration with Sales

• Oversee product profitability and drive improvement measures with stakeholders

• Lead Product Care Team for assigned products and product families, defining and monitoring critical KPIs, regularly reporting to customers and Tecan management

• Implement corrective measures when KPIs deviate from targets, leading cross-functional teams to ensure success

• Apply your business mindset and client & market understanding to grow the partnership through driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products that align with the client’s needs

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and continuously seek improvements to Tecan processes

• Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion within the team and broader organization.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering; further education in Product Management, Project Management or Business Administration

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life sciences

• 5+ years’ experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and/or product/lifecycle management

• Experience working with customers/partners in a B2B setting, OEM experience is a plus

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and/or complex products (HW, SW, services)

• Expertise in negotiating complex contracts, particularly in development and supply agreements is a plus

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations

• Strong communication skills, experience in communication to executives is a plus

• Team-oriented, customer-focused, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated

• Willingness to travel worldwide (10–20%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

• You’re detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a real impact by transforming data into actionable business strategies? At Tecan, we are looking for a Strategy & Sales Excellence Specialist with a consulting background to join our EMEA Commercial Operations team.

Strategy & Sales Excellence Specialist EMEA (80- 100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this influential role, you will be at the heart of our EMEA Commercial Operations, acting as a trusted advisor and analytical partner to senior leaders. You will dive deep into sales and market data, uncovering insights that drive strategic decisions and commercial excellence. By combining your consulting mindset with advanced analytical skills, you will transform complex information into clear, actionable recommendations and compelling stories that support business growth across Europe. Your ability to communicate effectively and collaborate across functions will empower teams to make fact-based decisions and achieve ambitious goals.

Responsibilities

• Collect, structure, and analyze sales funnel and performance data to provide transparency and actionable insights for the EMEA region.

• Translate complex data into clear business messages, dashboards, and high-quality presentations for executive stakeholders.

• Prepare regular business updates, executive summaries, and performance reviews, highlighting key risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.

• Drive the European forecast process by analyzing CRM funnel data, tracking specific opportunities as needed, consolidating all opportunity data into a comprehension “forecast”, and monitoring forecast accuracy.

• Track and report on sales opportunities, market trends, and competitor insights to inform commercial strategies.

• Act as a consulting-style sparring partner for commercial leaders, helping to frame business questions, structure analysis, and prepare recommendations.

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations to drive strategic initiatives and support commercial performance.

• Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, and reporting templates for commercial leadership and regional performance reviews.

• Support business reviews by creating structured storylines around performance and strategic initiatives.

• Assist regional teams with ad-hoc analysis, business cases, and account deep-dives to identify growth opportunities and risks.

Your background

We’re looking for more than just technical skills—we value curiosity, analytical thinking, and the ability to communicate insights with impact.

• 2–3 years of professional experience in consulting, business research, market intelligence, or commercial performance analysis.

• Degree in Business, Science or Engineering

• Proven ability to break down complex problems, structure analysis, and deliver clear recommendations.

• Advanced skills in Excel are a must. Experience with other data analysis tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Business Warehouse) is a plus.

• Experience preparing high-quality PowerPoint presentations and executive summaries for senior audiences.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; German or other languages are a plus.

• Confident, collaborative, and proactive mindset with strong business acumen.

• Ability to influence and lead across organizational boundaries, and work effectively in cross-functional teams.

• Willingness to travel internationally as required.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our EHS Office team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Product Environmental Compliance Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this important and hands-on role, you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product environmental compliance at Tecan, responsible for ensuring global compliance with all relevant product environmental and sustainability regulations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will operationally execute compliance processes and lead multiple complex regulatory projects across various Tecan sites. Your expertise will help shape Tecan’s approach to regulated substances in articles, extended producer responsibility, and the implementation of effective compliance strategies, all within a dynamic environment where regulatory developments are proactively monitored and integrated into our compliance efforts.

Responsibilities

• Execute Tecan’s global SOPs for compliance with regulated substances in articles and extend producer responsibility (RoHS, REACH, POP, TSCA, Conflict Minerals, WEEE, batteries, packaging) including collection of supplier declarations and preparation of compliance documentation

• Lead and implement multiple complex regulatory projects, ensuring efficient prioritization and execution (e.g. RoHS 6b, PFAS)

• Manage the global product environmental compliance database, including compliance software and data maintenance.

• Secure compliance with local extended producer responsibility obligations (WEEE, packaging, batteries), including registrations and reporting.

• Contribute to surveillance and analysis of the global regulatory landscape, supporting the development of long-term compliance strategies.

• Support technical evaluation of new regulations, early risk identification, and design of mitigation strategies.

• Act as a subject matter expert for senior leaders and cross-functional teams, answering internal and external queries.

• Provide training on product environmental compliance topics and perform internal/intra-company audits.

• Maintain clear compliance status reporting and coordinate issuing of compliance certificates and Critical Mineral reporting.

• Possibility to represent Tecan in trade associations, ensuring alignment with industry standards.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Higher education degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; chemical background is a plus.

• 5+ years of experience in product stewardship or product environmental regulations, preferably in MedTech.

• Experience implementing complex product environmental requirements.

• Familiarity with product environmental regulations and standards (RoHS, REACH, POP, PFAS, WEEE, Batteries, Packaging).

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

• Strong communicator able to explain the “why” behind regulations to diverse audiences.

• Project management experience in a matrix organization.

• Experience in material management, especially SAP.

• Pragmatic, solution-driven working style with a sense of urgency and a strong track record of meeting deadlines.

• Ability to prioritise effectively.

• Willingness to travel internationally (<10%).

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Produktionstechnik, -gestaltung und Logistik

• Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Medizintechnik-/Bio-Pharma, Automatisierungs-, Automobil- und/oder Aviatik-Industrie

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Nebst fachlicher Expertise sind wir auch auf der Suche nach einer Persönlichkeit, welche durch proaktives Handeln und dem Drang nach stetiger Verbesserung hervorsticht.

·         Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

·         Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

·         Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

·         Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Finance and Controlling team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior IT Data Analyst (100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

• Analyze and visualize business data to support decision-making

• Develop, optimize, and maintain SAP HANA models and reporting solutions

• Integrate data from ERP, CRM, finance, and other systems

• Create dashboards and KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud; explore new BI tools.

• Lead or support BI and digital transformation projects

• Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance (e.g., GDPR)

• Provide 2nd/3rd level support and training to business users

• Document data flows, models, and methodologies

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Extensive experience as a data analyst/BI specialist in SAP HANA

• Strong knowledge of SAP Datasphere, SAP ERP (S/4), SAP Analytics Cloud, and ETL tools

• Experience in data modeling, SQLScript, and performance optimization

• Understanding of SAP S4 data structures (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP)

• Excellent analytical, communication, and project management skills

• Hands on experience in Project Management

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

• Team player with a structured, independent work style.

• Degree in business IT, data science, or similar is a nice to have

• Experience with OneStream, Salesforce TableauNext, PowerBI would be a plus

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Project Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this pivotal role, you will take the lead on development projects from end to end, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and achievement of key performance objectives. You will have full ownership and accountability for mid-sized projects, including internal initiatives and customer specific projects.

Responsibilities

• Defining and building project teams with the right cross-functional mix of professional skills.

• Managing the planning, staffing, and execution of development projects for lab automation and clinical diagnostics according to applicable development processes.

• Planning, monitoring, and reporting on complex projects, coordinating interfaces with related projects.

• Ensuring proactive and proper communication within the organization and with stakeholders, including management board members.

• Demonstrating clear leadership within the organization towards all management levels.

• Coordinating team members located across multiple locations.

• Through leadership and methodological competence, ensure efficient implementation and adherence to processes, guidelines, and regulations, such as: ISO 13485, IEC 61010, and the machinery directive (2006/42/EC).

• Lead and coordinate cross-functional team activities across departments to ensure successful delivery of project goals — from feasibility studies and product development through design transfer and industrialization.

• Drive effective stakeholder management and proactively resolve conflicts within the project team and across stakeholders.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• BSc or MSc in a technical degree in a technical field, preferably in engineering, life sciences, mechanical or electrical disciplines.

• A PhD in Life Sciences, along with project management education, PMP or similar certifications, and training in change management and leadership, will set you apart.

• At least 3 years of experience in project management, preferably in the development of complex instruments or automated solutions for diagnostic applications.

• Experience in product management and business administration is a bonus.

• Fluent in English; additional languages (German and others) are a plus.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Proven experience in leading highly regulated product development projects, with a focus on automation, assay development, and agile project management.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Ti sei mai chiesto come le tue abilità e il tuo background unico potrebbero influenzare il mondo di domani? Unisciti al nostro team R&D e porta la tua passione e talento al lavoro.

Project Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo fondamentale, si prenderanno il vantaggio di progetti di sviluppo da fine a fine, garantendo la consegna tempestiva, la conformità del bilancio e il raggiungimento di obiettivi di prestazioni chiave. Avrete piena proprietà e responsabilità per progetti di medie dimensioni, tra cui iniziative interne e progetti specifici per i clienti.

responsabilità

• Definire e costruire team di progetto con il giusto mix interfunzionale di competenze professionali.

• Gestire la pianificazione, il personale e l'esecuzione di progetti di sviluppo per l'automazione del laboratorio e la diagnostica clinica secondo i processi di sviluppo applicabili.

• Pianificazione, monitoraggio e reporting su progetti complessi, coordinando le interfacce con progetti correlati.

• Garantire una comunicazione proattiva e corretta all'interno dell'organizzazione e con gli stakeholder, compresi i membri del consiglio di amministrazione.

• Dimostrare una chiara leadership all'interno dell'organizzazione verso tutti i livelli di gestione.

• Coordinare i membri del team situati in più posizioni.

• Attraverso la leadership e la competenza metodologica, garantire l'implementazione e l'adesione efficienti a processi, linee guida e regolamenti, come: ISO 13485, IEC 61010 e la direttiva sulle macchine (2006/42/CE).

• Guidare e coordinare le attività di team interfunzionali in tutti i reparti per garantire la consegna di obiettivi di progetto, dagli studi di fattibilità e dallo sviluppo dei prodotti attraverso il trasferimento di progettazione e l'industrializzazione.

• Guidare la gestione efficace delle parti interessate e risolvere proattivamente i conflitti all'interno del team di progetto e tra le parti interessate.

Il tuo sfondo

Non siamo solo alla ricerca di abilità dure: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• BSc o MSc in grado tecnico in un campo tecnico, preferibilmente in ingegneria, scienze della vita, discipline meccaniche o elettriche.

• Un PhD in Scienze della Vita, insieme con l'istruzione di gestione del progetto, PMP o certificazioni simili, e la formazione nella gestione dei cambiamenti e la leadership, vi farà a pezzi.

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione del progetto, preferibilmente nello sviluppo di strumenti complessi o soluzioni automatizzate per applicazioni diagnostiche.

• L'esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti e nell'amministrazione aziendale è un bonus.

• Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive (tedesco e altri) sono un plus.

• Ottima capacitÃ di presentazione e comunicazione, con la capacitÃ di trasmettere in modo efficace soluzioni tecniche sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico

• Esperienza dimostrata nei principali progetti di sviluppo di prodotti altamente regolamentati, con un focus sull'automazione, lo sviluppo di saggi e la gestione agile del progetto.

W hat fa lavorare a Tecan unico

La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di presentazione, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, elevati standard e ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

Haben Sie sich jemals gefragt, wie Ihre Fähigkeiten und Ihr einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen könnten? Treten Sie unserem R & D-Team bei und bringen Sie Ihre Leidenschaft und Ihr Talent zur Arbeit.

Projektmanager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Ihr Beitrag

In dieser zentralen Rolle übernehmen Sie die Führung bei Entwicklungsprojekten von Ende zu Ende und gewährleisten eine rechtzeitige Lieferung, die Einhaltung des Budgets und die Erreichung der wichtigsten Leistungsziele. Sie haben die volle Verantwortung für mittelgroße Projekte, einschließlich interner Initiativen und kundenspezifischer Projekte.

Zuständigkeiten

• Definieren und Aufbauen von Projektteams mit dem richtigen funktionsübergreifenden Mix professioneller Kompetenzen.

• Leitung der Planung, Personalbesetzung und Durchführung von Entwicklungsprojekten für Laborautomation und klinische Diagnostik gemäß den anwendbaren Entwicklungsprozessen.

• Planung, Überwachung und Berichterstattung über komplexe Projekte, Koordination der Schnittstellen mit verwandten Projekten.

• Sicherstellung einer proaktiven und ordnungsgemäßen Kommunikation innerhalb der Organisation und mit Stakeholdern, einschließlich Vorstandsmitgliedern.

• Nachweis einer klaren Führung innerhalb der Organisation gegenüber allen Managementebenen.

• Koordinierende Teammitglieder an mehreren Standorten.

• Durch Führungs- und Methodenkompetenz sorgen Sie für eine effiziente Umsetzung und Einhaltung von Prozessen, Richtlinien und Vorschriften wie ISO 13485, IEC 61010 und der Maschinenrichtlinie (2006/42/EG).

• Führen und koordinieren Sie abteilungsübergreifend funktionsübergreifende Teamaktivitäten, um die erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Projektziele sicherzustellen – von Machbarkeitsstudien und Produktentwicklung bis hin zu Designtransfer und Industrialisierung.

• Führen Sie ein effektives Stakeholder-Management und lösen Sie proaktiv Konflikte innerhalb des Projektteams und zwischen den Stakeholdern.

Dein Hintergrund

Wir suchen nicht nur nach Hard Skills: Wir suchen Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent in die Arbeit bringen.

• BSc oder MSc in einem technischen Grad in einem technischen Bereich, vorzugsweise in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biowissenschaften, mechanischen oder elektrischen Disziplinen.

• Ein PhD in Life Sciences, zusammen mit Projektmanagement-Ausbildung, PMP oder ähnlichen Zertifizierungen und Ausbildung in Change Management und Führung, werden Sie auszeichnen.

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, vorzugsweise in der Entwicklung komplexer Instrumente oder automatisierter Lösungen für diagnostische Anwendungen.

• Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und in der Betriebswirtschaft ist ein Bonus.

• Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen (Deutsch und andere) sind ein Plus.

• Hervorragende Präsentations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen sowohl für technische als auch für nicht-technische Zielgruppen effektiv zu vermitteln

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von stark regulierten Produktentwicklungsprojekten mit Fokus auf Automatisierung, Assay-Entwicklung und agilem Projektmanagement.

W Hat macht das Arbeiten bei Tecan einzigartig

Die Chance, dass es zählt und einen Einfluss auf die Welt von morgen hat

• Arbeiten in einem internationalen und vielfältigen Umfeld

• Die Chance, Ihre Karriere innerhalb des Unternehmens zu erweitern

• Fühlen Sie sich durch unsere starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur gestärkt

• Umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket

Treten Sie Tecan bei, einem großartigen Ort zum Arbeiten! Lesen Sie mehr über unsere jüngste Zertifizierung von Great Place to Work .

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung online. Bitte reichen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf oder Lebenslauf ein (mit Bild und Anschreiben, Referenzschreiben und Diplomen sind optional).

Unser Ziel.

Bei Tecan sind wir bestrebt, das Leben und die Gesundheit der Menschen zu verbessern. Wir tun dies, indem wir unsere Kunden in die Lage versetzen, Gesundheitsinnovationen weltweit von der Biowissenschaft bis zur Klinik zu skalieren. Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden von der Frühphase der Innovation bis zur Projektumsetzung und darüber hinaus zusammen. Wir liefern die Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Lösungen, die Laborprozesse und medizinische Verfahren präzise, reproduzierbar und konform machen.

Bleib einzigartig und lass es zählen.

Unsere Werte - Vertrauen, höchste Standards und Ehrgeiz - sind die Eckpfeiler unseres Geschäfts und bilden den Rahmen für die Kultur von Tecan. Wir fördern ein positives und ermächtigendes Umfeld, in dem unsere seltensten Vermögenswerte, unsere einzigartigen Mitarbeiter, wachsen und ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent einbringen können.

Gestionnaire de projet (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Votre contribution

Dans ce rôle central, vous dirigerez les projets de développement de bout en bout, assurant l'exécution en temps opportun, la conformité budgétaire et la réalisation des principaux objectifs de rendement. Vous aurez la pleine propriété et la responsabilité pour les projets de taille moyenne, y compris les initiatives internes et les projets spécifiques à la clientèle.

Responsabilités

• Définir et construire des équipes de projet avec le bon mélange de compétences professionnelles.

• Gérer la planification, la dotation et l'exécution des projets de développement pour l'automatisation des laboratoires et le diagnostic clinique selon les processus de développement applicables.

• Planification, suivi et rapports sur les projets complexes, coordination des interfaces avec les projets connexes.

• Assurer une communication proactive et adéquate au sein de l'organisation et avec les intervenants, y compris les membres du conseil de gestion.

• Démontrer un leadership clair au sein de l'organisation à tous les niveaux de gestion.

• Les membres de l'équipe de coordination se trouvent à plusieurs endroits.

• Grâce à des compétences en matière de leadership et de méthodologie, assurer une mise en œuvre et un respect efficaces des processus, des lignes directrices et des règlements, tels que la norme ISO 13485, la norme CEI 61010 et la directive sur les machines (2006/42/CE).

• Diriger et coordonner les activités des équipes interfonctionnelles dans tous les ministères afin d'assurer la réalisation des objectifs du projet, depuis les études de faisabilité et la mise au point de produits jusqu'au transfert de conception et à l'industrialisation.

• Favoriser une gestion efficace des intervenants et résoudre les conflits de façon proactive au sein de l'équipe du projet et entre les intervenants.

Vos antécédents

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement des compétences difficiles: Nous recherchons des personnes qui apportent leur passion et leur talent au travail.

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences techniques dans un domaine technique, de préférence en génie, sciences de la vie, sciences mécaniques ou électriques.

• Un doctorat en sciences de la vie, ainsi qu'une formation en gestion de projet, PMP ou certifications similaires, et une formation en gestion du changement et en leadership, vous sépareront.

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, de préférence dans le développement d'instruments complexes ou de solutions automatisées pour les applications diagnostiques.

• L'expérience en gestion de produits et en administration des affaires est un bonus.

• Fluent en anglais; langues supplémentaires (allemand et autres) sont un plus.

• Excellente capacité de présentation et de communication, avec la capacité de transmettre efficacement des solutions techniques aux publics techniques et non techniques

• Expérience éprouvée dans la conduite de projets de développement de produits hautement réglementés, en mettant l'accent sur l'automatisation, le développement de tests et la gestion de projets agiles.

W chapeau fait travailler à Tecan unique

La chance de le faire compter et d'avoir un impact sur le monde de demain

• Travailler dans un environnement international et diversifié

• La chance de développer votre carrière au sein de l'entreprise

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en donnant à nos clients les moyens d'étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

jobs.description:
Senior Asset Manager

Full-Time
 Morgan Hill, CA | Onsite

Make an Impact With Our Team

Are you a strategic supply chain professional who thrives on solving complex material challenges, building strong customer relationships, and driving operational excellence? We are seeking a Senior Asset Manager to join our Supply Chain team and play a critical role in ensuring material availability, supporting customer programs, and optimizing inventory performance.

In this role, you'll manage material planning, customer-owned inventory, excess inventory resolution, procurement coordination, and commodity strategies while partnering closely with Purchasing, Planning, Program Management, and customers. You'll proactively identify supply risks, develop mitigation plans, and help ensure products are delivered on time to support business objectives.

If you're analytical, customer-focused, and passionate about supply chain strategy and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Material Planning & Inventory Management
 • Analyze material requirements for production kits over a rolling 6–8-week planning horizon.
 • Plan and commit material for assigned customer programs to support production schedules.
 • Identify material shortages or supply gaps that could impact kit readiness and customer deliveries.
 • Monitor material availability and proactively mitigate supply risks that may impact revenue.
 • Perform Bill of Materials (BOM) profile analyses to identify sole-source components, long lead-time items, risk buys, and obsolete inventory.
 • Conduct Engineering Change Order (ECO) material impact analysis and disposition planning.

• Customer Asset & Inventory Management
 • Manage customer-owned inventory purchases and coordinate material alignment with Program Management.
 • Provide customers with weekly excess inventory approval requests and drive timely resolution.
 • Coordinate excess inventory sales, BOM updates, and material shipments back to customers.
 • Partner with customers to process purchase order revisions resulting from inventory adjustments or final count variances.
 • Prepare and analyze monthly excess inventory reports, validating inventory status and recommending corrective actions.
 • Ensure component cancellations and material returns are completed for assigned customer accounts.

Supply Chain Coordination
 • Partner with Commodity Buyers to monitor pull-in activities and resolve material shortages.
 • Run "What-If" analyses to support customer pull-in and push-out requests.
 • Develop and implement commodity and material management strategies that improve supply continuity and inventory performance.
 • Collaborate with Purchasing, Planning, Program Management, Manufacturing, and Customer Service to resolve material issues and support operational goals.

Continuous Improvement
 • Maintain accurate reporting and documentation to support inventory planning and customer communications.
 • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, inventory management, and operational efficiency.
 • Support quarterly material risk mitigation initiatives and continuous improvement programs.
 • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and customers while delivering exceptional service.

What You Bring

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
 • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
 • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service.
 • Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
 • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
 • Proven ability to make sound decisions and follow through on commitments.
 • Collaborative approach with the ability to work cross-functionally across Supply Chain, Purchasing, Planning, Manufacturing, and Customer teams.
 • High level of initiative, accountability, and professionalism.
 • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills for reporting, analysis, and data management.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
 • 5–7 years of experience in materials management, supply chain, or inventory management.
 • 3–5 years of experience in planning, procurement, or purchasing.
 • Experience working within ERP/MRP systems.
 • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
 • Experience performing material planning, inventory analysis, and supply risk management.
 • Experience supporting customer-owned inventory and excess inventory resolution.

Nice to Haves

• APICS (CPIM) or NAPM certification.
 • MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration or a related field.
 • Experience with ManEx and Spotlight software.
 • Experience developing commodity strategies and supplier management initiatives.
 • Knowledge of electronic manufacturing services (EMS) or contract manufacturing environments.
 • Experience leading cross-functional supply chain improvement initiatives.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
 • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.
 • 401(k) with company match.
 • Paid time off and company holidays.
 • Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
 • Collaborative and team-oriented work environment.
 • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

Salary Range: 100K-120K
 (Compensation is based on education, experience, skills, internal equity, and market data.)

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Senior Asset Manager

Tempo pieno
Morgan Hill, CA | Onsite

Fare un impatto con il nostro team

Sei un professionista della supply chain strategica che prospera nella soluzione di complesse sfide materiali, nella costruzione di forti relazioni con i clienti e nella guida dell'eccellenza operativa? Stiamo cercando un Senior Asset Manager per unire il nostro team di Supply Chain e svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la disponibilità dei materiali, sostenere i programmi dei clienti e ottimizzare le prestazioni dell'inventario.

In questo ruolo, gestirai la pianificazione dei materiali, l'inventario di proprietà del cliente, la risoluzione dell'inventario in eccesso, il coordinamento degli appalti e le strategie delle materie prime, collaborando a stretto contatto con Acquisti, Pianificazione, Gestione dei programmi e clienti. Identificare proattivamente i rischi di approvvigionamento, sviluppare piani di mitigazione e aiutare a garantire che i prodotti vengano consegnati in tempo per sostenere gli obiettivi aziendali.

Se siete analitici, orientati al cliente e appassionati di strategia della supply chain e miglioramento continuo, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

• Gestione della pianificazione e dell'inventario dei materiali
• Analizzare i requisiti materiali per i kit di produzione in un orizzonte di pianificazione di 6-8 settimane.
• Pianificare e commettere materiale per i programmi dei clienti assegnati per sostenere i programmi di produzione.
• Identificare la carenza di materiale o le lacune di fornitura che potrebbero influenzare la disponibilità di kit e le consegne dei clienti.
• Monitorare la disponibilità dei materiali e mitigare proattivamente i rischi di approvvigionamento che possono influenzare i ricavi.
• Eseguire l'analisi del profilo di Bill of Materials (BOM) per identificare i componenti delle sole risorse, gli elementi a lungo termine, gli acquisti dei rischi e l'inventario obsoleto.
• Conduct Engineering Change Order (ECO) analisi dell'impatto materiale e pianificazione delle disposizioni.

• Gestione del patrimonio e dell'inventario dei clienti
• Gestisci gli acquisti dell'inventario del cliente e coordina l'allineamento del materiale con la gestione del programma.
• Fornire ai clienti richieste di approvazione dell'inventario in eccesso settimanali e guidare la risoluzione tempestiva.
• Coordinare le vendite di inventario in eccesso, aggiornamenti BOM e spedizioni materiali di nuovo ai clienti.
• Partner con i clienti per elaborare le revisioni degli ordini di acquisto derivanti da modifiche dell'inventario o variazioni del conteggio finale.
• Preparare e analizzare i report mensili dell'inventario in eccesso, convalidare lo stato dell'inventario e raccomandare azioni correttive.
• Assicurare le cancellazioni dei componenti e i rendimenti dei materiali sono completati per gli account dei clienti assegnati.

Coordinamento della supply chain
• Partner con Commodity Buyers per monitorare le attività di pull-in e risolvere la carenza di materiale.
• Eseguire analisi "What-If" per supportare le richieste di pull-in e push-out del cliente.
• Sviluppare e implementare strategie di gestione delle materie prime e dei materiali che migliorano la continuità dell'offerta e le prestazioni dell'inventario.
• Collabora con l'acquisto, la pianificazione, la gestione del programma, la produzione e il servizio clienti per risolvere i problemi materiali e sostenere gli obiettivi operativi.

Miglioramento continuo
• Mantenere report e documentazione accurate per supportare la pianificazione dell'inventario e le comunicazioni dei clienti.
• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi di pianificazione, la gestione dell'inventario e l'efficienza operativa.
• Supporta iniziative di mitigazione dei rischi materiali trimestrali e programmi di miglioramento continuo.
• Costruire relazioni forti con gli stakeholder interni e i clienti, offrendo un servizio eccezionale.

Che cosa porta

• Forte analitica, pensiero critico e capacità di problem solving.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta, verbale e interpersonale.
• Mindset focalizzato sul cliente con un impegno a fornire un servizio eccezionale.
• Capacità di dare priorità a più progetti in un ambiente di produzione veloce.
• Forte capacità organizzative con eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli.
• Prove capacità di prendere decisioni solide e seguire gli impegni.
• L'approccio collaborativo con la capacità di lavorare in modo trasversale attraverso i team di Supply Chain, Acquisizione, Pianificazione, Produzione e Clienti.
• Alto livello di iniziativa, responsabilità e professionalità.
• Avanzate competenze Microsoft Excel per la reportistica, l'analisi e la gestione dei dati.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business, Operazioni, o un campo relativo.
• 5-7 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei materiali, nella supply chain o nella gestione delle scorte.
• 3-5 anni di esperienza nella pianificazione, nell'approvvigionamento o nell'acquisto.
• Esperienza di lavoro all'interno dei sistemi ERP/MRP.
• Competenza con applicazioni Microsoft Office.
• Sperimenta la pianificazione dei materiali, l'analisi dell'inventario e la gestione dei rischi di approvvigionamento.
• Esperienza che supporta l'inventario del cliente e la risoluzione dell'inventario in eccesso.

Bello da Avere

• APICS (CPIM) o certificazione NAPM.
• MBA o Master in Business Administration o in un campo correlato.
• Esperienza con il software ManEx e Spotlight.
• Sperimenta strategie di sviluppo delle materie prime e iniziative di gestione dei fornitori.
• Conoscenza dei servizi di produzione elettronica (EMS) o degli ambienti di produzione di contratti.
• Esperienza delle principali iniziative di miglioramento della supply chain interfunzionale.

Cosa offriamo

• Compensazione competitiva e pacchetto completo di benefici.
• Assicurazione medica, dentale e visione.
• 401(k) con fiammifero aziendale.
• Tempo pagato e vacanze aziendali.
• Opportunità di sviluppo professionale e di promozione della carriera.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e orientato al team.
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo sulla soddisfazione del cliente e sull'eccellenza operativa.

Salary Range: 100K-120K
(La Compensazione si basa su istruzione, esperienza, competenze, equità interna e dati di mercato.)

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

Senior Asset Manager

Vollzeit
Morgan Hill, CA | Vor Ort

Machen Sie eine Wirkung mit unserem Team

Sind Sie ein strategischer Supply-Chain-Experte, der sich für die Lösung komplexer materieller Herausforderungen, den Aufbau starker Kundenbeziehungen und die Förderung operativer Exzellenz einsetzt? Wir suchen einen Senior Asset Manager, der unserem Supply Chain Team beitritt und eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung der Materialverfügbarkeit, der Unterstützung von Kundenprogrammen und der Optimierung der Lagerleistung spielt.

In dieser Rolle verwalten Sie Materialplanung, kundeneigenes Inventar, übermäßige Lagerauflösung, Beschaffungskoordination und Rohstoffstrategien und arbeiten eng mit Einkauf, Planung, Programmmanagement und Kunden zusammen. Sie identifizieren proaktiv Versorgungsrisiken, entwickeln Minderungspläne und tragen dazu bei, dass Produkte pünktlich geliefert werden, um die Geschäftsziele zu unterstützen.

Wenn Sie analytisch, kundenorientiert und leidenschaftlich an Supply-Chain-Strategie und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung interessiert sind, würden wir uns freuen, von Ihnen zu hören.

Wie werden Sie eine Wirkung erzielen?

• Materialplanung & Bestandsverwaltung
• Analysieren Sie die Materialanforderungen für Produktionskits über einen rollenden Planungshorizont von 6 bis 8 Wochen.
• Planen und verpflichten Sie Material für zugewiesene Kundenprogramme, um Produktionspläne zu unterstützen.
• Identifizieren Sie Materialmangel oder Versorgungslücken, die sich auf die Einsatzbereitschaft und die Kundenlieferungen auswirken könnten.
• Überwachung der Materialverfügbarkeit und proaktive Minderung von Versorgungsrisiken, die sich auf den Umsatz auswirken können.
• Führen Sie Profilanalysen von Bill of Materials (BOM) durch, um Einzelkomponenten, lange Vorlaufzeiten, Risikokäufe und veraltetes Inventar zu identifizieren.
• Conduct Engineering Change Order (ECO) Materialfolgenanalyse und Dispositionsplanung.

• Customer Asset & Inventarmanagement
• Verwalten Sie kundeneigene Bestandskäufe und koordinieren Sie die Materialausrichtung mit dem Programmmanagement.
• Stellen Sie Ihren Kunden wöchentliche Genehmigungsanträge für Überbestände zur Verfügung und sorgen Sie für eine rechtzeitige Lösung.
• Koordinieren Sie überschüssige Lagerverkäufe, Stücklistenaktualisierungen und Materiallieferungen an die Kunden.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, um Bestellrevisionen zu verarbeiten, die aus Bestandsanpassungen oder endgültigen Zählabweichungen resultieren.
• Bereiten und analysieren Sie monatliche Überbestandsberichte, validieren Sie den Bestandsstatus und empfehlen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Komponentenstornierungen und Materialrücksendungen für zugewiesene Kundenkonten abgeschlossen sind.

Supply Chain Koordination
• Zusammenarbeit mit Commodity Buyers, um Pull-in-Aktivitäten zu überwachen und Materialknappheit zu beheben.
• Führen Sie "What-If"-Analysen aus, um Kunden-Pull-In- und Push-Out-Anfragen zu unterstützen.
• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Rohstoff- und Materialmanagementstrategien, die die Versorgungskontinuität und die Lagerleistung verbessern.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Einkauf, Planung, Programmmanagement, Fertigung und Kundenservice zusammen, um wesentliche Probleme zu lösen und operative Ziele zu unterstützen.

Kontinuierliche Verbesserung
• Pflegen Sie genaue Berichte und Dokumentationen, um die Bestandsplanung und die Kundenkommunikation zu unterstützen.
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Planungsprozessen, Bestandsverwaltung und operativer Effizienz.
• Unterstützung vierteljährlicher Initiativen zur Minderung von Materialrisiken und kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsprogramme.
• Bauen Sie starke Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern und Kunden auf und bieten Sie gleichzeitig außergewöhnlichen Service.

Was du mitbringst

• Starke analytische, kritisches Denken und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten.
• Hervorragende schriftliche, verbale und zwischenmenschliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
• Kundenorientierte Denkweise mit der Verpflichtung, außergewöhnlichen Service zu bieten.
• Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte in einer schnelllebigen Fertigungsumgebung zu priorisieren.
• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit außergewöhnlicher Liebe zum Detail.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und Verpflichtungen einzuhalten.
• Kollaborativer Ansatz mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifend in Supply Chain-, Einkaufs-, Planungs-, Fertigungs- und Kundenteams zu arbeiten.
• Hohes Maß an Initiative, Verantwortlichkeit und Professionalität.
• Erweiterte Microsoft Excel-Fähigkeiten für Reporting, Analyse und Datenmanagement.

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• 5-7 Jahre Erfahrung im Materialmanagement, Supply Chain oder Inventarmanagement.
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in Planung, Beschaffung oder Einkauf.
• Erfahrung in ERP/MRP-Systemen.
• Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office-Anwendungen.
• Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Materialplanung, Bestandsanalyse und Versorgungsrisikomanagement.
• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von kundeneigenem Inventar und übermäßiger Inventarauflösung.

Nett zu Haves

• APICS (CPIM) oder NAPM Zertifizierung.
• MBA oder Master-Abschluss in Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich.
• Erfahrung mit ManEx und Spotlight Software.
• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Rohstoffstrategien und Initiativen zum Lieferantenmanagement.
• Kenntnisse der elektronischen Fertigungsdienste (EMS) oder Auftragsfertigungsumgebungen.
• Erleben Sie führende funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Lieferkette.

Was wir anbieten

• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung und umfassendes Leistungspaket.
• Medical, Dental und Vision Versicherung.

Directeur principal des biens

Morgan Hill (C.A.) Sur place

Faites un impact avec notre équipe

Êtes-vous un professionnel de la chaîne d'approvisionnement stratégique qui prospère en résolvant des défis matériels complexes, en établissant de solides relations avec la clientèle et en stimulant l'excellence opérationnelle? Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire principal d'actifs pour rejoindre notre équipe de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et jouer un rôle essentiel pour assurer la disponibilité du matériel, soutenir les programmes des clients et optimiser la performance des stocks.

Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez la planification du matériel, les stocks appartenant à la clientèle, la résolution excédentaire des stocks, la coordination des achats et les stratégies de produits tout en vous associant étroitement aux achats, à la planification, à la gestion des programmes et aux clients. Vous identifierez de façon proactive les risques d'approvisionnement, élaborerez des plans d'atténuation et vous assurerez que les produits sont livrés à temps pour appuyer les objectifs opérationnels.

Si vous êtes analytique, axé sur le client et passionné par la stratégie de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et l'amélioration continue, nous aimerions vous entendre.

Comment allez - vous avoir un impact?

• Planification du matériel et gestion des stocks
• Analyser les exigences en matière de matériaux pour les trousses de production sur une période de planification de 6 à 8 semaines.
• Planifier et engager du matériel pour les programmes clients assignés afin de soutenir les calendriers de production.
• Identifier les pénuries matérielles ou les lacunes d'approvisionnement qui pourraient avoir une incidence sur l'état de préparation des trousses et les livraisons des clients.
• Surveiller la disponibilité du matériel et atténuer proactivement les risques d'approvisionnement qui peuvent avoir une incidence sur les recettes.
• Effectuer des analyses de profils de bill of Materials (BOM) pour identifier les composants à fournisseur unique, les articles à long terme, les achats de risques et les stocks obsolètes.
• Effectuer l'analyse d'impact et la planification de l'élimination de l'ordonnance de modification technique (ECO).

• Gestion des biens et des stocks des clients
• Gérer les achats d'inventaire appartenant à la clientèle et coordonner l'alignement du matériel avec la gestion du programme.
• Fournir aux clients des demandes hebdomadaires d'approbation d'inventaire excédentaire et conduire la résolution en temps opportun.
• Coordonner les ventes excédentaires d'inventaire, les mises à jour de BOM et les expéditions de matières aux clients.
• S'associer avec les clients pour traiter les révisions des commandes résultant de rajustements des stocks ou des écarts de comptage final.
• Préparer et analyser les rapports mensuels sur les stocks excédentaires, valider l'état des stocks et recommander des mesures correctives.
• S'assurer que les annulations de composants et les retours importants sont effectués pour les comptes clients assignés.

Coordination de la chaîne d'approvisionnement
• Établir un partenariat avec les acheteurs de marchandises pour surveiller les activités de retrait et résoudre les pénuries matérielles.
• Exécutez des analyses "What-If" pour soutenir les demandes de retrait et de retrait du client.
• Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de gestion des produits et des matériaux qui améliorent la continuité de l'approvisionnement et le rendement des stocks.
• Collaborer avec le Service des achats, de la planification, de la gestion des programmes, de la fabrication et de la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes matériels et appuyer les objectifs opérationnels.

Amélioration continue
• Tenir des rapports et des documents exacts pour appuyer la planification des stocks et les communications avec les clients.
• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer les processus de planification, la gestion des stocks et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
• Appuyer les initiatives trimestrielles d'atténuation des risques matériels et les programmes d'amélioration continue.
• Établir des relations solides avec les intervenants internes et les clients tout en offrant un service exceptionnel.

Ce que vous apportez

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de pensée critique et de résolution de problèmes.
• Excellente capacité de communication écrite, verbale et interpersonnelle.
• L'esprit axé sur le client avec un engagement à fournir un service exceptionnel.
• Capacité de prioriser plusieurs projets dans un environnement de fabrication rapide.
• Fortes compétences organisationnelles avec une attention exceptionnelle aux détails.
• Capacité éprouvée de prendre des décisions judicieuses et de respecter les engagements.
• Approche collaborative permettant de travailler de façon interfonctionnelle dans les équipes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des achats, de la planification, de la fabrication et de la clientèle.
• Niveau élevé d'initiative, de responsabilité et de professionnalisme.
• Compétences avancées de Microsoft Excel pour les rapports, l'analyse et la gestion des données.

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat en gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, en affaires, en opérations ou dans un domaine connexe.
• 5 à 7 ans d'expérience en gestion des matériaux, en chaîne d'approvisionnement ou en gestion des stocks.
• 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans la planification, l'approvisionnement ou l'achat.
• Expérience de travail au sein des systèmes ERP/RPM.
• Compétence avec les applications Microsoft Office.
• Expérience dans la planification du matériel, l'analyse des stocks et la gestion des risques liés à l'offre.
• Expérience de soutien des stocks appartenant à la clientèle et résolution excédentaire des stocks.

Sympa d'avoir

• Certification APICS (CPIM) ou NAPM.
• MBA ou maîtrise en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.
• Expérience avec le logiciel ManEx et Spotlight.
• Expérience de l'élaboration de stratégies de produits et d'initiatives de gestion des fournisseurs.
• Connaissance des services de fabrication électronique (SME) ou des environnements de fabrication contractuels.
• Expérience des initiatives d'amélioration de la chaîne d'approvisionnement transfonctionnelle.

Ce que nous offrons

• Compensation concurrentielle et ensemble complet d'avantages.
• Assurance médicale, dentaire et visuelle.
• 401(k) avec match d'entreprise.
• Des congés payés et des jours fériés.
• Développement professionnel et possibilités d'avancement professionnel.
• Environnement de travail axé sur la collaboration et l'équipe.
• Possibilité d'avoir un impact significatif sur la satisfaction de la clientèle et l'excellence opérationnelle.

Gamme salariale : 100K-120K
(L'indemnisation est fondée sur l'éducation, l'expérience, les compétences, l'équité interne et les données du marché.)

Notre but.

Chez Tecan, nous sommes déterminés à améliorer la vie et la santé des gens. Nous le faisons en responsabilisant nos clients à étendre l'innovation en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, depuis les sciences de la vie jusqu'à la clinique. Nous collaborons avec nos clients depuis l'innovation en phase initiale jusqu'à la mise en œuvre de projets et au-delà. Nous fournissons les produits, services et solutions qui rendent les processus de laboratoire et les procédures médicales précis, reproductibles et conformes.

Restez unique et faites-le compter.

Nos valeurs - la confiance, les normes les plus élevées et l'ambition - sont les pierres angulaires de notre entreprise et constituent le cadre de la culture de Tecan. Nous favorisons un environnement positif et autonomisant où nos atouts les plus rares, nos employés uniques, peuvent grandir et apporter leur passion et leur talent au travail.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

VP, Head System Solutions R&D (80- 100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive the strategic direction of System Solutions R&D for Tecan’s complex life sciences and medical technology portfolio. You will shape the system architecture vision, oversee multidisciplinary teams, and ensure the integrity and excellence of our products across hardware, software, applications, automation, and regulated workflows. From concept to market launch and lifecycle management, you will be the senior leader ensuring our solutions are safe, effective, and ready for the world.

Responsibilities

• Provide strategic leadership for the System Solutions R&D function, setting vision and direction for systems engineering, architecture, integration, and application science.

• Own and maintain the system architecture, strategy, and technology roadmap across the product portfolio.

• Set standards for requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration across multidisciplinary teams.

• Partner with PMO, Product Management, Marketing, and Business Leaders to shape portfolio strategy and define product roadmaps.

• Lead early-stage technical due diligence, feasibility assessments, and risk evaluations for investment decisions.

• Champion best practices in design controls, risk management, verification, and validation.

• Provide executive technical oversight for integration, system verification, and release readiness decisions.

• Build and grow technical leadership within the function, including hiring, performance management, and talent development.

• Foster strong partnerships across functions and represent System Solutions in executive reviews and governance forums.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement, technical excellence, and innovation.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; Master’s degree preferred.

• Advanced business education or a business degree is a nice to have.

• 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, product development, and innovation within life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices, or other highly regulated industries.

• Proven success leading system architecture and cross-functional technical execution for complex multidisciplinary products.

• Strong track record of building and leading high-performing teams in global, matrixed organizations.

• Demonstrated senior leadership experience in building and developing multidisciplinary R&D organizations.

• Skilled at coaching, mentoring, and developing technical leaders within the organization.

• Comfortable leading across geographies and cultures, promoting diversity and inclusion.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience with digital/data-driven products or AI-assisted workflows is a plus.

• Willingness to travel internationally (30%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.
